FN-EJLIIC2-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 9
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Gerald H. Allen
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/19/2026
Senate Bill 9 as introduced could increase receipts to: (1) the State General Fund from civil
penalties imposed for using an electronic nicotine delivery system in violation of the provisions
of this bill by a maximum of $50 for the first violation, $100 for a second violation, and $200
for each subsequent violation; and (2) the district or municipal courts by an undetermined
amount, dependent on the increase in the number of violations pursuant to the provisions of this
bill.
Page 1
